verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents seller onboarding, dispute handling and compliant card tokenization. None of it states who owns KYC/AML, card-network compliance, fraud losses or seller misconduct between the platform and Finix. Those features are adjacent and do not show an explicit responsibility split in the docs.

support.subject: As an ops user, the responsibility split is explicit — who owns KYC/AML, card-network compliance, fraud losses, and seller misconduct between me and the provider, in the docs rather than the contract's fine print
